description: A U_PDU that asked for node delivery confirmation and has no CAS answer within sis.confirm_wait_ms is rejected to its client with reason 3, Destination Node Not Responding.
note: Link setup and data path as dts-arq/data-ack-roundtrip: conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ with node delivery confirmation (Service Type 0x14), its S_UNIDATA_REQUEST of 'ping' to SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3 at 0 is held for a soft link while the CAS calls, and at 91000 the peer's PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED makes the link and the U_PDU goes down to the CAS (A-0194, A-0217 to A-0220); at 108000 it goes on air in one DATA-ONLY, and at 118350 dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts. On acceptance the U_PDU asked for confirmation and is held for a soft link, so its wait runs to its TTD, 0 + 648000 x 2000 ms (interp A-0232, A-0342): sis.confirm_wait starts with 1296000000 ms, the only entry in the deadline list. Handed to the CAS at 91000, its wait becomes 60000 ms (A-0221; interp A-0232): sis.confirm_wait restarts with 60000. No acknowledgement comes. At 151000 sis.confirm_wait expires with no CAS response, so the client gets S_UNIDATA_REQUEST_REJECTED reason 3 (A-0225, A-0107, A-0108) with destination SAP 9, address 0.0.1.3 and the whole U_PDU (A-0109 to A-0111); the list is empty, so nothing restarts. The C_PDU stays with the DTS, which retransmits it at dts.ack_wait (178350, after the end of the trace); a later CAS answer for it is ignored (interp A-0342). Fixture, addresses and draws as dts-arq/data-ack-roundtrip: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block; seed 0 draws 15, 4: contention waits 45000 and 12000 ms (K-0080). Since corpus 0.28.0 (P7-3), every D_PDU this node sends to a peer recorded Ed4 carries EOW 0xF01, CAPABILITY (Ed4 1, Duplex 0), where it carried EMPTY (C-0426, C-1260); an owed UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR still goes first (C-1079), and D_PDUs to a peer of unknown edition, a peer recorded Ed3 or a group carry EMPTY as before. Where this note says EOW 0 or EMPTY for such a D_PDU, read CAPABILITY. Only EOW and header CRC bytes changed.
